scope: Isolated status and session-log public APIs with synthetic filesystem injection; no HTTP, inference or product-default changes.

validation.queue_payload: 499 NUL code points plus emoji; actual JSON escaping and UTF-8 pending bytes
validation.failure_semantics: Injected backend errors are not kernel write-error proof. Warning callback panic/rejection and Promise/Future identity are explicit API adaptations.

log: random launch filename component omitted; files identified by original session_id or anonymous
normalization.write_counts: Exact only at held-write barriers; ordinary scheduler-dependent counts are descriptive.
normalization.clock: Validation injects fixed event time; real timers retain ordinary scheduling and are used only for progress/deadline guards.

measurement.quantile: legacy floor((n-1)*p); each raw sample retained; paired protocol reports this explicitly, never pools with HTTP protocols
measurement.native_flush_boundary: poll the retained pinned flush future once to Pending/Ready, then drive that exact future to completion; future construction is excluded
measurement.thresholds: No native numerical acceptance threshold ratified. Paired descriptive results do not qualify representative hardware, gateway performance or historical synchronous-baseline gates.
measurement.resources: No allocations, descriptor, CPU or peak-RSS qualification in this protocol; missing metrics remain null.

legacy_comparison.scope: Unmarked historical schema_version=1 runs only; never accept native storage or HTTP protocol reports.
